Markets.title: US stock: S&P 500 ends lower as investors weigh data, Middle East tensions
Markets.summary: The S&P 500 fell from its peak as weaker retail sales and rising Middle East tensions weighed on investor sentiment. Meanwhile, declines in Applied Materials dragged down AI-related stocks, though rising oil prices and Reddit's index inclusion provided some gains.

Markets.title: Nvidia’s $500 billion plan envelops Wall Street in its AI frenzy
Markets.summary: Nvidia has launched a $500 billion financing initiative with major financial institutions to help AI startups purchase computing chips. This strategy aims to address the surging global demand for artificial intelligence hardware and digital infrastructure.

Markets.title: How a $900 million bet on SpaceX turned 100x into $94 billion for Alphabet
Markets.summary: Alphabet's initial $900 million investment in SpaceX has grown by 100x to become worth approximately $94 billion. This massive return makes Alphabet the largest institutional shareholder in the rocket company.

Markets.title: Patanjali Foods Q1 Results: Gross profit rises 35% YoY to Rs 1,521 crore
Markets.summary: Patanjali Foods reported a 29.33% increase in revenue to ₹11,337 crore and a 35.22% rise in gross profit to ₹1,521 crore for the first quarter of fiscal 2027. The company also declared two interim dividends driven by strong execution across its business segments.

Markets.title: Global Markets: Hotter Europe isn't cooling investor fervor for stocks
Markets.summary: Despite costly summer heatwaves impacting European industries like agriculture and tourism, stock exchanges in Paris, Frankfurt, Madrid, and Milan reached record highs in August. These European market milestones mirrored recent all-time highs for key Wall Street indexes.

Markets.title: Accel India IV offloads 1.3 pc stake in Urban Company
Markets.summary: Investor Accel India IV sold a 1.3 percent stake in Urban Company through open market deals on August 13, 2026. This transaction reduced the Mauritius-based firm's holdings to 4.84 percent of the home services company.

Geo-Political.title: Mangione admits killing healthcare CEO and pleads guilty to federal charges
Geo-Political.summary: Twenty-eight-year-old Mangione pleaded guilty to federal stalking charges resulting in death. He admitted in court to shooting and killing UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson in Manhattan.

Geo-Political.title: Afghan women tell the BBC their lives are unrecognisable after five years of Taliban rule
Geo-Political.summary: Five years after the Taliban took control of Afghanistan, women report that their lives are unrecognizable due to severe restrictions. They face public floggings, job losses, and dangerous barriers to accessing healthcare.

Geo-Political.title: US aircraft carrier on way to relieve USS Lincoln after issues reported on board
Geo-Political.summary: A US aircraft carrier has been deployed to relieve the USS Lincoln following reports of food shortages and broken plumbing on board. Some sailors on the Lincoln have reportedly considered jumping overboard due to these conditions.

Geo-Political.title: Instagram accounts fuelling Ceuta crisis with paid advice for help to cross
Geo-Political.summary: A BBC investigation revealed that Instagram accounts are promoting and providing paid advice on how to illegally swim around the Morocco-Ceuta border fence. These profiles are actively fueling the ongoing migration crisis at the Spanish enclave.

Geo-Political.title: Activists try to deliver aid to Palestinians in homes besieged by Israeli settlers
Geo-Political.summary: Activists attempted to deliver humanitarian aid to two Palestinian families trapped in their West Bank homes by Israeli settlers. The families have been besieged in their residences for several days.

Geo-Political.title: 'Unprecedented' rain in Japan kills eight people
Geo-Political.summary: Unprecedented rain in Japan killed eight people and cut power to more than 20,000 households. The severe storm also left 7,000 people stranded at Tokyo's Narita airport.

AI & Tech.summary: An affiliate marketer discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when they asked ChatGPT for the best course on the subject. The author achieved this free traffic without using paid advertising.

Data & Insights.title: India's WPI inflation cools marginally to 9.78% in July as fuel prices ease
Data & Insights.summary: India's Wholesale Price Index inflation cooled marginally to 9.78% in July as fuel and power inflation moderated to 20.05% from 27.41% in June. Meanwhile, inflation in primary articles and manufactured products accelerated during the same period.

Data & Insights.title: India’s merchandise trade gap widens to a six-month high of $31.98 bn in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's merchandise trade gap widened to a six-month high of $31.98 billion in July. Meanwhile, merchandise exports for the April-July period rose 17% to $173.78 billion compared to the previous year.

Data & Insights.title: US consumer inflation falls to 3.4% year-on-year in July: Govt
Data & Insights.summary: U.S. consumer inflation slowed to 3.4% year-on-year in July amid fluctuating oil prices. This decrease matched analyst expectations and may offer the Federal Reserve greater flexibility regarding interest rates.

Data & Insights.title: India's retail inflation breaches RBI's midpoint target for second successive month, rises to 4.45% in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 4.45% in July, staying above the Reserve Bank of India's 4% midpoint target for the second consecutive month. This increase was driven by higher food and fuel prices, while elevated oil prices continue to pose economic risks.

Data & Insights.title: Fitch retains India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for 20th year, forecasts GDP growth at 6.4% — Here's what it means
Data & Insights.summary: Fitch Ratings has maintained India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for the twentieth consecutive year due to a strong growth outlook, while projecting a 6.4% GDP growth rate. The agency also highlighted potential fiscal risks stemming from youth protests over employment issues.

Data & Insights.title: The Sanjeev Sanyal interview: A new age of ideas for India
Data & Insights.summary: Sanjeev Sanyal states that artificial intelligence is making traditional university models obsolete. He also believes that ensuring workforce employability is a greater challenge for India than simply creating jobs.

India.title: 6 Arrested In Connection With Occultist's Murder In UP: Cops
India.summary: Varanasi police in Uttar Pradesh have arrested six people for the alleged murder of occultist Anish Upadhyay. Upadhyay was reportedly killed after being called to perform rituals for a family experiencing financial troubles and illness.

India.title: Man Accused Of Attacking Sukhbir Badal Sent To Police Custody Till August 24
India.summary: Jaspal Singh was sent to police custody until August 24 by a Nanded court on Friday. The 62-year-old is accused of attacking Shiromani Akali Dal chief Sukhbir Singh Badal.

India.title: Green India Mission Fell Short By 98% In Increasing Forest Cover: CAG
India.summary: The Comptroller and Auditor General reported that the Green India Mission achieved a forest cover increase of only 0.03 million hectares between 2015 and 2025. This result fell 97.57 percent short of the targeted 1.4 million hectares.

India.title: Man Arrested For Allegedly Threatening To Kill Hemant Soren
India.summary: A man was arrested in Ranchi on Friday for allegedly threatening to kill Jharkhand Chief Minister Hemant Soren. The threat was made during protests regarding alleged irregularities in recruitment examinations.

India.title: Census 2027 To Collect Mobile, Aadhaar, Bank Account Details
India.summary: The upcoming Census 2027 will collect respondents' mobile numbers, Aadhaar details, and bank account information. This marks a departure from previous censuses conducted between 1872 and 2011, which did not request these document details.

India.title: Homoeopaths Can't Practice Other System Of Medicine: Homoeopathy Panel
India.summary: A homeopathy panel stated that homeopaths are prohibited from practicing any other system of medicine. However, an exception to this regulation exists for practitioners working under government programs.

General.title: Jason Arday, ex-Cambridge professor at centre of plagiarism row, found dead
General.summary: Jason Arday, a former Cambridge professor who was recently at the center of a plagiarism controversy, was found dead in London on Friday. His family expressed profound shock at the loss of the academic, father, partner, brother, uncle, and son.

General.title: Fires prompt national alert as 19 homes destroyed
General.summary: Thirty-seven fires are currently burning across England and Wales, prompting a national alert. The blazes have destroyed 19 homes, according to the prime minister.

General.title: Temporary ban on sale of disposable BBQs over wildfire risk
General.summary: The government has temporarily banned the sale of disposable barbecues due to the severe wildfire risk caused by ongoing drought and heatwave conditions. Officials warn that single-use grills pose a significant danger to the public during this extreme weather.

General.title: Five years after the Taliban swept to power, does the West have any influence?
General.summary: Five years after the Taliban took control of Afghanistan, experts are questioning whether Western nations retain any leverage or bargaining power. The situation prompts debate over the effectiveness of current international policies regarding the regime.

General.title: Mangione admits killing healthcare CEO and pleads guilty to federal charges
General.summary: Twenty-eight-year-old Mangione admitted to shooting and killing a healthcare CEO in Manhattan. He pleaded guilty to federal charges of stalking resulting in death.

General.title: Derailed Essex to London train leads to travel chaos
General.summary: A derailed Essex to London train caused widespread travel chaos for commuters. Ambulance crews evaluated more than 60 patients at the scene, all of whom were discharged.
